source: Release v5 (built from b79e66a): the tools of its surface.json; endpoint, upstreamName and inputSchema from its registry.json. Tool contracts only.

displayName.description: Exact student display name from the current user request; never guess a native key.

purpose.description: The current user request or its purpose. Reading does not authorize authoring or saving.

currentRequestRef.description: Reference to this current user request; not an approval or credential.

lessonDate.description: Omit for today in Asia/Seoul. An explicit date must fall inside the owner-admitted range.

questionCounts.description: Cardinal question counts only, e.g. {count:8,rendering:"8문항"}. Type ordinals such as 유형 10 belong in requiredFragments, not questionCounts.
